summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp., a Nasdaq-listed Bio-Native AI company (formerly ImmunoPrecise Antibodies), filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Kim Remizowski as an independent director effective September 29, 2026. Remizowski, a veteran banker and CIMA-licensed director, joins the Audit Committee and the Compensation, Nomination and Governance Committee, qualifying as an audit committee financial expert. The board now comprises four directors, three independent. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special-situation event; no deal terms, advisors, or transaction mechanics are present.
